finding.title: Hardcoded password comparison (use Argon2id/bcrypt)
finding.evidence: assert((sanitized.nested as Record<string, unknown>).backupPassword === '[REDACTED]', 'nested password field should be redacted');
finding.description: Passwords must be hashed using Argon2id before comparison. Never compare plaintext passwords.

fix.guidance: Use argon2.verify(hashedPassword, inputPassword) for password comparison.
